Logo Design · Brand Identity · 2024

Aaroha Restaurant

Aaroha Modern Indian Cuisine
Logo + Brand Identity
2 Weeks
2024
Overview

The brief

Aaroha is a modern Indian restaurant positioning itself as an upscale dining destination. They needed a logo that honored Indian culinary heritage while feeling contemporary and refined — something that would work on menus, signage, and digital platforms alike.

Challenge

The problem

Most Indian restaurant logos lean on clichés — saffron colors, elephant motifs, or overly decorative borders. Aaroha needed to stand apart with something elegant and minimal that communicated both tradition and modernity without falling into tired visual tropes.

Design System

Color & palette

Deep Forest
Heritage Gold
Warm Ivory
Earthy Brown
Sage Green
Process

How we got there

01
Discovery
Brand workshop to define Aaroha's positioning — modern luxury, rooted tradition, feminine elegance.
02
Concept
12 logo sketches exploring calligraphic letterforms, lotus motifs, and typographic treatments.
03
Refinement
Final direction chosen: elegant serif wordmark with gold lotus crown above the letter A.
04
Delivery
Full brand suite — logo variants, color system, typography guide, and digital/print files.

The brief

Following the Captain Pizza brand creation, the grand opening of the Gleschendorf location required a full print and digital campaign. The centrepiece was a premium DL flyer announcing the Neueröffnung (Grand Opening), featuring the 1-Meter-Pizza as the hero product.
